# UpahJe.my

> Plain, sourced answers about technology for Malaysian small businesses, in English and Bahasa Melayu.

This site publishes short, citable articles. Every claim links to a source; every article states when those sources were checked. Prefer the canonical URL of each language version.

## Concept index

- [Compliance](https://upahje.my/en/topics/compliance): What the rules require, what they do not, and what is unpublished. (2 articles)
- [Pematuhan](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/compliance): Apa yang dikehendaki peraturan, apa yang tidak, dan apa yang tidak diterbitkan. (2 articles)
- [Buying](https://upahje.my/en/topics/buying): What work costs, how to brief it, and how to compare quotes. (11 articles)
- [Pembelian](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/buying): Kos kerja, cara menulis brief, dan cara membandingkan sebut harga. (11 articles)
- [AI and automation](https://upahje.my/en/topics/ai-automation): Agents, models and the loop that runs your request. (8 articles)
- [AI dan automasi](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/ai-automation): Agent, model dan gelung yang menjalankan permintaan anda. (8 articles)
- [Operations and growth](https://upahje.my/en/topics/operations-growth): How the business runs week to week, and where the duplication hides. (4 articles)
- [Operasi dan pertumbuhan](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/operations-growth): Cara perniagaan berjalan setiap minggu, dan di mana pertindihan bersembunyi. (4 articles)
- [Freelance](https://upahje.my/en/topics/freelance): Selling a skill per project, with the listings counted. (1 article)
- [Bebas](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/freelance): Menjual kemahiran setiap projek, dengan kiraan senarai. (1 article)

## English articles

- [Colab will train your model. It will not host it](https://upahje.my/en/articles/colab-hosting-ai-malaysia): Google's own FAQ bans file hosting, media serving and web services on Colab, and blocks SSH on the free tier. What it does allow, and what hosting costs.
- [EPF contribution: 12% or 13%, and RM5,000 is the line](https://upahje.my/en/articles/epf-employer-rate-malaysia): The employer rate is 13% at RM5,000 and below and 12% above it, but the contribution comes from the Third Schedule and rounds up, not from a calculator.
- [The same H100 rents for RM11.89 an hour, or RM7.12](https://upahje.my/en/articles/gpu-rental-cost-malaysia): Runpod lists an H100 SXM at USD 4.39 an hour and Vast.ai at USD 1.73 for the same silicon. The spread is billing model and idle capacity, not hardware.
- [HRD Corp levy: 1%, 0.5%, or none](https://upahje.my/en/articles/hrd-corp-levy-malaysia): The levy starts at five Malaysian employees and is compulsory at ten, at 0.5% or 1% of monthly wages. A first hire carries none of it.
- [POS: RM122 a month, and no free tier files e-invoice](https://upahje.my/en/articles/pos-system-cost-malaysia): StoreHub starts at RM122 and Qashier charges by the day. No free POS plan documents MyInvois compliance; the RM0 plan that does is accounting software.
- [SOCSO stops at RM6,000](https://upahje.my/en/articles/socso-employer-rate-malaysia): Employer SOCSO is 1.75% and employee 0.5% up to a RM6,000 ceiling, with EIS 0.2% each side. Above the cap a raise costs the employer nothing extra.
- [A spare laptop is a server only after you measure it](https://upahje.my/en/articles/spare-laptop-home-server-malaysia): Idle watts, a battery that is not a UPS, and a tariff you have to read yourself. The arithmetic that decides whether the free machine is actually free.
- [A trading bot is a data problem wearing a model's clothes](https://upahje.my/en/articles/trading-bot-reality-malaysia): Nine symbols, 17.9 minutes of GPU time and RM0.58 of compute produced a model that made one decision for every coin. The model was never the problem.
- [Grab and foodpanda commission rates (2026)](https://upahje.my/en/articles/delivery-commission-malaysia): What Grab and foodpanda actually charge merchants in Malaysia: the MyCC bands, what they exclude, and why at 25% a RM25 order leaves RM8.50 before labour.
- [A first hire at RM3,000 costs RM3,448.50 a month](https://upahje.my/en/articles/first-hire-cost-malaysia): EPF, SOCSO, EIS and the LINDUNG 24 Jam deduction, line by line on a RM3,000 salary, with what is capped, what rounds up and what the payslip misses.
- [Two free tools against OpusClip: the Malay caption gap](https://upahje.my/en/articles/self-hosted-clipping): OpusClip charges USD 15 a month, or RM61.78 converted. Two open-source projects clip locally for no licence fee, and neither has shown reliable Malay captions.
- [CommandCode, OpenCode, DeepSeek: not the same kind of tool](https://upahje.my/en/articles/commandcode-opencode-deepseek-numbers): One is a paid CLI, one is a free CLI, one is an API. Their published prices, their drift, and one run that shows an exit code of zero is not success.
- [Google Business Profile: the fields that decide visibility](https://upahje.my/en/articles/google-business-profile-fields): Google documents name rules, category rules, hours and what triggers suspension: what an SME should fix first, and the four fields that get restricted.
- [What a leaderboard row actually measures](https://upahje.my/en/articles/leaderboard-row-anatomy): SWE-bench and Terminal-bench score a model inside someone else's harness. The DeepSeek row is the example, and the run behind it has a reliability profile.
- [Don't rewrite your site. Rewrite the 5%.](https://upahje.my/en/articles/rewrite-the-five-percent): Two MIT repos five days apart, 11,986 stars between them on 24 November 2026, prescribe opposite fixes for a slow app. The disagreement says which you need.
- [Where the same data gets typed three times](https://upahje.my/en/articles/same-data-typed-three-times): 97.2% of establishments use computers. The duplication sits between a digitised front office and a manual back office, and e-Invoice forces one record right.
- [What an AI agent can and cannot do for a small business](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-an-ai-agent-can-do): An AI agent runs a loop on its own: reads a task, calls tools, checks, repeats. What that covers unattended, what needs a human, and what none should touch.
- [The e-Invoice threshold is now RM3 million](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-einvoice-automation-covers): LHDN raised the e-Invoice exemption to RM3 million on 1 September 2026, freeing 1.1 million traders. What is required, what is not, and what is unpublished.
- [What a WhatsApp chatbot costs, per message](https://upahje.my/en/articles/whatsapp-chatbot-costs-malaysia): Free to 1,000 service messages a month and free for anything a customer sends. Marketing costs RM0.3467, and a Malaysian vendor adds RM200 to RM1,500.
- [Your first automation should not be your worst process](https://upahje.my/en/articles/your-first-automation-wrong-process): Opinion. The process an owner hates most is often the worst to automate first: automating it removes evidence and hides the exceptions that decide the cost.
- [Agent harness, AI harness, agent framework: what they mean](https://upahje.my/en/articles/agent-harness-vs-ai-harness): An agent harness runs the loop: it executes tool calls, holds the transcript, applies permissions. Vendors say agent harness; AI harness is not their term.
- [Four coding-agent CLIs on one machine: what we tested](https://upahje.my/en/articles/agent-harnesses-ranked): Only one of the four completed the end-to-end task. The other three were assessed from their versions, configuration and documented interfaces, not a benchmark.
- [Automation work: 30 published prices](https://upahje.my/en/articles/automation-rates-malaysia-published): Thirty published prices for automation work from four Malaysian studios, one independent and one freelancer, checked November 2026. Some pages undated.
- [Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok: what differs](https://upahje.my/en/articles/closed-models-differences): Scores settle little here. What you are stuck with is context window, price per token and documented capability, every cell sourced or marked not captured.
- [API or spreadsheet: which fits your volume](https://upahje.my/en/articles/do-you-need-an-api-or-a-spreadsheet): A spreadsheet wins at low volume with one owner; an API wins when two systems must sync. Three cases where a sheet is right, four signals it stopped scaling.
- [Where an API key goes in a harness, and where never](https://upahje.my/en/articles/harness-api-keys): A harness reads your key from an environment variable or its store. What the key authenticates, four places it must never appear, and what to do if it leaks.
- [Agent harnesses: who makes them, what is open](https://upahje.my/en/articles/harness-landscape-open-closed): Grok Bot and Dots are closed hosted products. OpenBot and MausBot are source-available, and only one is open source on its own licence; a licence row for each.
- [How to brief an automation job so you don't pay twice](https://upahje.my/en/articles/how-to-brief-an-automation-job): Five things a freelancer needs before quoting, a reusable brief template, and the acceptance test to agree before work starts, written for a Malaysian SME.
- [Open weights, four licence types: what each model allows](https://upahje.my/en/articles/open-models-differences): Four open-weight families, five model cards, four licence shapes: MIT on DeepSeek, a custom Qwen licence, Mistral's own. What each permits and its rental cost.
- [Open or closed models: what an SME can run in-house](https://upahje.my/en/articles/open-vs-closed-models-malaysia): An open-weight model can be downloaded and run on hardware you control: cost per month in Malaysia, the volume where it beats per-call pricing, and the skills.
- [What RM100 a month buys in AI](https://upahje.my/en/articles/rm100-budget): RM100 buys a seat in a subscription app or a meter of API tokens. The Bank Negara rate of 19 November 2026, three usage levels, and where tokens win.
- [What 11 freelance listings offered for five skills](https://upahje.my/en/articles/side-income-skills-malaysia-2026): Video editing, design, data entry, cold calling and app testing appeared in 11 public listings on one platform. What clients advertised, and what it proves.
- [What an agent harness is, and what it does with your request](https://upahje.my/en/articles/using-the-harness): A harness sits between you and the model: it holds the conversation, runs tools, sends each request and streams the answer. What one message looks like.
- [What is an API, for a small business owner](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-is-an-api-for-malaysian-sme): An API is a contract that lets two systems exchange data without a human copying it. What it means for a Malaysian SME, open versus closed models, and the cost.

## Bahasa Melayu articles

- [Colab akan latih model anda. Ia tidak akan hoskan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/colab-hosting-ai-malaysia): FAQ Google melarang hosting fail, penyajian media dan perkhidmatan web di Colab, serta menyekat SSH pada tier percuma. Apa yang dibenarkan, dan kos hos.
- [EPF majikan: 12% atau 13%, dan RM5,000 garisnya](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kadar-caruman-epf-majikan): Kadar majikan 13% pada RM5,000 ke bawah dan 12% ke atas, tetapi caruman datang daripada Jadual Ketiga dan dibundarkan ke atas, bukan daripada kalkulator.
- [SOCSO berhenti pada RM6,000](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kadar-socso-majikan-malaysia): SOCSO majikan 1.75% dan pekerja 0.5% sehingga siling RM6,000, dengan EIS 0.2% setiap pihak. Melebihi siling, kenaikan gaji tidak menambah kos majikan.
- [H100 yang sama disewa RM11.89 sejam, atau RM7.12](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kos-sewa-gpu-malaysia): Runpod menyenaraikan H100 SXM pada USD 4.39 sejam dan Vast.ai pada USD 1.73 untuk cip yang sama. Jurang itu model bil dan kapasiti terbiar, bukan perkakasan.
- [POS: RM122 sebulan, dan tiada tier percuma fail e-invoice](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kos-sistem-pos-malaysia): StoreHub bermula RM122 dan Qashier mengenakan caj harian. Tiada pelan POS percuma mendokumen pematuhan MyInvois; pelan RM0 yang berbuat begitu ialah perakaunan.
- [Laptop lama jadi pelayan hanya selepas anda ukurnya](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/laptop-lama-jadi-pelayan-malaysia): Watt melahu, bateri yang bukan UPS, dan tarif yang perlu anda baca sendiri. Aritmetik yang menentukan sama ada mesin percuma itu benar-benar percuma.
- [Levi HRD Corp: 1%, 0.5%, atau tiada](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/levi-hrd-corp-malaysia): Levi bermula pada lima pekerja Malaysia dan wajib pada sepuluh, pada 0.5% atau 1% gaji bulanan. Pekerja pertama tidak menanggungnya.
- [Bot dagangan ialah masalah data yang memakai pakaian model](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/realiti-bot-dagangan-malaysia): Sembilan simbol, 17.9 minit masa GPU dan RM0.58 kos pengkomputeran menghasilkan model yang membuat satu keputusan bagi setiap syiling. Model bukan masalahnya.
- [Dua alat percuma lawan OpusClip: jurang sari kata Melayu](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/klip-video-sendiri): OpusClip mengenakan USD 15 sebulan, atau RM61.78 ditukar. Dua projek sumber terbuka memotong klip sendiri tanpa fi, dan sari kata Melayu belum terbukti.
- [Komisen Grab dan foodpanda (2026)](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/komisen-penghantaran-malaysia): Apa yang Grab dan foodpanda sebenarnya caj peniaga di Malaysia: julat MyCC, apa yang tidak termasuk, dan kenapa pada 25% pesanan RM25 tinggal RM8.50.
- [Pekerja pertama bergaji RM3,000 berharga RM3,448.50](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kos-pekerja-pertama-malaysia): EPF, SOCSO, EIS dan potongan LINDUNG 24 Jam, baris demi baris pada gaji RM3,000, dengan apa yang dihadkan, apa yang dibundarkan dan apa yang slip gaji terlepas.
- [Apa yang sebenarnya diukur oleh satu baris papan pendahulu](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/anatomi-baris-papan-pendahulu): SWE-bench dan Terminal-bench menilai model di dalam harness orang lain. Baris DeepSeek contohnya, dan larian di belakangnya ada profil kebolehpercayaan.
- [Apa yang AI agent boleh buat untuk PKS](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-yang-agent-boleh-buat): AI agent menjalankan gelung sendiri: baca tugasan, panggil tool, ulang. Apa yang dibuat tanpa penyeliaan, apa yang perlukan manusia, apa yang jangan disentuh.
- [Ambang e-Invoice kini RM3 juta](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-yang-automasi-e-invoice-liputi): LHDN menaikkan pengecualian e-Invoice kepada RM3 juta pada 1 September 2026, melepaskan 1.1 juta peniaga. Apa yang diwajibkan, apa yang tidak.
- [Automasi pertama anda bukan proses yang paling anda benci](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/automasi-pertama-bukan-proses-terburuk): Pendapat. Proses yang paling dibenci pemilik selalunya yang paling buruk untuk diautomasikan: ia membuang bukti dan menyembunyikan pengecualian penentu kos.
- [CommandCode, OpenCode, DeepSeek: bukan jenis alat yang sama](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/commandcode-opencode-deepseek-angka): Satu CLI berbayar, satu CLI percuma, satu API. Harga yang diterbitkan, perubahannya, dan satu larian yang menunjukkan kod keluar sifar bukan kejayaan.
- [Di mana data yang sama ditaip tiga kali](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/data-sama-ditaip-tiga-kali): 97.2% pertubuhan guna komputer, jadi penggunaan bukan masalah. Penduaan antara pejabat hadapan digital dan belakang manual, dan e-Invoice memaksa rekod betul.
- [Kos chatbot WhatsApp: setiap mesej, setiap bulan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kos-chatbot-whatsapp-malaysia): Percuma hingga 1,000 mesej servis sebulan dan percuma untuk mesej pelanggan. Pemasaran RM0.3467; vendor Malaysia menambah RM200 hingga RM1,500.
- [Google Business Profile: medan penentu sama ada anda muncul](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/medan-google-business-profile): Google mendokumenkan peraturan nama, kategori, waktu dan pencetus penggantungan; apa patut PKS betulkan dahulu, dan empat medan yang menghadkan profil.
- [Jangan tulis semula laman anda. Tulis semula 5% itu.](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/tulis-semula-lima-peratus): Dua repo MIT lima hari selang, 11,986 bintang pada 24 November 2026, nasihat bertentangan untuk aplikasi lambat. Perselisihan itu menentukan pembetulan.
- [Agent harness, AI harness, agent framework: maksudnya](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/agent-harness-atau-ai-harness): Agent harness menjalankan gelung agent: melaksanakan tool call, menyimpan transkrip, menguatkuasakan kebenaran. Vendor guna agent harness, bukan AI harness.
- [Apa itu agent harness, dan apa yang ia buat](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-itu-agent-harness): Harness berada antara anda dan model: ia menyimpan perbualan, menjalankan tools, menghantar permintaan dan menstrim jawapan. Rupa satu mesej di dalamnya.
- [Apa itu API, untuk pemilik perniagaan kecil](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-itu-api-untuk-pks-malaysia): API ialah kontrak antara dua sistem untuk bertukar data tanpa orang menyalinnya. Maksudnya bagi PKS, beza model terbuka dengan tertutup, dan kos menyambungnya.
- [Apa yang RM100 sebulan beli dalam AI](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/bajet-rm100-ai-malaysia): RM100 beli tempat duduk dalam aplikasi langganan, atau meter token API. Penukaran pada kadar Bank Negara 19 November 2026, tiga tahap guna, bila token menang.
- [Pemberat terbuka, empat lesen: apa setiap model benarkan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/beza-model-terbuka): Empat keluarga, lima kad model, empat bentuk lesen: MIT pada DeepSeek, lesen Qwen tersuai, lesen terbuka Mistral sendiri. Apa yang dibenarkan dan kos sewa.
- [Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini dan Grok: apa yang berbeza](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/beza-model-tertutup): Skor penanda aras tidak memutuskan banyak di sini. Yang terikat: tetingkap konteks, harga token dan keupayaan didokumenkan, setiap sel bersumber atau ditanda.
- [Cara menulis brief kerja automasi](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/cara-tulis-brief-kerja-automasi): Lima perkara yang freelancer perlukan sebelum memberi sebut harga, templat brief boleh guna semula, dan ujian penerimaan dipersetujui sebelum kerja bermula.
- [Empat CLI agent pada satu mesin: apa yang kami uji](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/harness-agent-disusun): Hanya satu daripada empat menyelesaikan tugasan hujung ke hujung. Tiga lagi dinilai daripada versi dan konfigurasi, bukan penanda aras.
- [Kos kerja automasi: 30 harga diterbitkan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kos-automasi-malaysia-harga-diterbitkan): 30 harga kerja automasi dari empat studio, satu pengamal bebas dan satu freelancer, disemak November 2026; beberapa halaman tiada tarikh.
- [Di mana kunci API diletakkan, dan di mana tidak](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kunci-api-dalam-harness): Harness membaca kunci daripada pemboleh ubah persekitaran atau stor kelayakan. Apa yang kunci itu sahkan, empat tempat terlarang, dan langkah jika ia bocor.
- [Harness agent: siapa buat, mana satu sumber terbuka](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/landskap-harness-agent-sumber-terbuka): Grok Bot dan Dots produk tertutup dihoskan. OpenBot dan MausBot sumber tersedia, hanya satu sumber terbuka pada lesen sendiri; setiap baris ada lesen dan bukti.
- [Apa 11 senarai freelance tawar untuk lima kemahiran](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/lima-kemahiran-pendapatan-sampingan-2026): Suntingan video, reka bentuk, kemasukan data, panggilan sejuk dan ujian aplikasi muncul dalam 11 senarai awam. Apa yang ditawarkan, dan apa yang ia buktikan.
- [Model terbuka atau tertutup: apa PKS boleh jalankan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/model-terbuka-atau-tertutup-pks-malaysia): Model terbuka boleh dimuat turun dan dijalankan pada perkakasan sendiri: kos sebulan, jumlah di mana ia kalahkan bayaran ikut panggilan, dan kemahiran.
- [API atau spreadsheet: pilih ikut jumlah](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/perlu-api-atau-cukup-spreadsheet): Spreadsheet menang pada jumlah kecil, satu pemilik; API menang apabila dua sistem harus selaras. Tiga keadaan spreadsheet betul, empat tanda ia tidak memadai.

## Repo directory

- [Video generation](https://upahje.my/en/repos/video-generation): The models and inference stacks you would actually run, not the app wrappers around them. (14 repos, GitHub API 2026-11-23)
- [Penjanaan video](https://upahje.my/ms/repos/video-generation): Model dan tindanan inferens yang benar-benar boleh dijalankan, bukan pembungkus aplikasi di sekelilingnya. (14 repo, API GitHub 2026-11-23)
- [Game development](https://upahje.my/en/repos/game-dev): Engines, frameworks and the asset path underneath them. (18 repos, GitHub API 2026-11-23)
- [Pembangunan permainan](https://upahje.my/ms/repos/game-dev): Enjin, rangka kerja dan laluan aset di bawahnya. (18 repo, API GitHub 2026-11-23)
- [Game studio pipeline](https://upahje.my/en/repos/game-studio): The jobs a studio does every week: art, audio, large files, builds. (14 repos, GitHub API 2026-11-23)
- [Saluran studio permainan](https://upahje.my/ms/repos/game-studio): Kerja yang dibuat studio setiap minggu: seni, audio, fail besar, binaan. (14 repo, API GitHub 2026-11-23)

## Library

- [Repos, SDKs and price pages](https://upahje.my/en/resources): every repository and price page the articles cite, with its licence and whether we ran it, read it, or only installed it.
- [Repo, SDK dan halaman harga](https://upahje.my/ms/resources): setiap repo dan halaman harga yang dipetik, dengan lesennya dan sama ada kami menjalankannya, membacanya, atau hanya memasangnya.

## Notes

- Each article lists its sources and the date they were checked.
- Draft articles are not published and are not listed here.
- English and Malay versions are separate, human-written pages linked by hreflang.
